verdict.rationale: A public marketplace for publishing and monetizing scrapers is a fair question for a browser-automation and scraping platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only first-party ready-made templates and the ability to deploy agents for your own use. Nothing documents publishing scrapers for others to use or earning revenue from them.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish my custom scraper to a public marketplace and earn revenue when others use it
